blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Sunday dared Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon to explain how an infrastructure project in Taguig City, which supposedly contained coordinates pointing outside verified project limits, should not be flagged as a “ghost” project. This followed Dizon’s earlier statement that there are “no ghost projects” in Taguig City. READ: No ghost projects in Taguig – Dizon In a social media post, Lacson cited a supposed finding of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) regarding “geotagged photographs attached to billing reports contained coordinates pointing outside verified project limits.” For instance, the […]...
